name: Wexford, Ireland

visa.notes: Stamp 0 visa for retirees requires ~€50K/year income. Must have private health insurance.

rent.notes: Daft.ie Q1 2026: County Wexford average EUR1,435; 2-bed house EUR1,372, 3-bed house EUR1,585. Typical sits between 2-bed and 3-bed house with a pet-friendly premium.

sources.title: Daft.ie Rental Report 2026 Q1 (PDF via RTE)

utilities.notes: Selectra Nov 2026 averages: electricity EUR157/mo and gas EUR129/mo for a gas-heated house (many Wexford houses are oil-heated at similar cost), plus Panda Essential EUR27.50/mo or AES Lite EUR23-24/mo bins; water and sewer free. Energy CPI up 18% y/y Oct 2026. Internet excluded.

sources.title: Selectra: Average gas and electricity bill Ireland (Nov 2026)
Selectra: Cheapest bin collection in Wexford
AJ Bell: Ireland inflation accelerates in October 2026 as energy prices surge

healthcare.notes: Two adults on private cover at the HIA market-average adult premium (EUR1,902/yr at end-2025, about EUR1,960 in Q1 2026) = roughly EUR160-165 each per month; budget public-hospital plans start near EUR550-600/yr per adult (min), mid-range day-to-day plans EUR2,500+/yr (max). Legal residents use the public system; no medical card at 60 unless means-tested. New arrivals have a 9-month window to buy cover before lifetime community rating age loading applies.

sources.title: Irish Examiner: Average health insurance premiums reach EUR1,902 (HIA bulletin, Mar 2026)

insurance.notes: Re-modelled from old template (stored EUR180 was health insurance, now carried in healthcare). Renters/contents only: Allianz quotes basic contents cover from about EUR10/mo, fuller cover about EUR15/mo (page dated 2019, nudged up).

sources.title: Allianz Ireland: How much does renters insurance cost

petDaycare.notes: Occasional use: Pawshake home boarding in County Wexford typically EUR45-50/night, sitters/daycare EUR14-35/day. Typical assumes ~4 daycare days a month plus one boarding week a year.

petGrooming.notes: Cork salon lists large-breed full groom from EUR90 (giant double-coated breeds typically more); Bernese de-shed/bath every 6-8 weeks averages about EUR75/mo, monthly visits toward the max.

sources.title: Kinsale Dog Spaw price list (Fresha)

transportation.notes: One petrol car, more rural driving than Waterford city: fuel EUR1.97/l (Oct 2026) ~EUR120/mo at 11,000 km/yr, motor insurance avg EUR655/yr in 2025 (new residents EUR680-1,100), plus motor tax, NCT and maintenance. Selectra rural car household EUR350-550. Free Travel pass from age 66.
